query: After a fresh ComfyUI install, importing a workflow JSON or PNG shows a success message but nothing is rendered when custom nodes are missing; user cannot tell which node packs are absent. Via API the error surfaces as invalid_prompt 'node RIFE VFI does not exist'.

desired.outcome: OP confirmed workaround: repeatedly query the API and manually install every missing node package until import succeeds; issue transferred to frontend (ComfyUI_frontend#7427) to show workflow with missing nodes.
desired.quality: Diagnosis identifies the correct root cause; fix actionable and directionally correct.
